title: Business Control File
$comment: Kill switch flag + grant map + waivers for one business workspace (R11). The reducer CLI (U3) is designed to be its only writer; the adapter tool allowlist and OS file permissions enforce that from inside a session (KTD7). Out-of-band tamper detection (R14) is done via the reducer's own manifest.json, which records a content hash per tracked document path outside this file — this document carries no stateHash field of its own.

provisioning.$comment: Non-secret provisioning config (adapters/provisioning), e.g. the digest from-address and a Doppler project/config binding. Optional and migrate-safe: absent means unset, never a placeholder default. Secret values never live here — only Doppler/.env do. dopplerProject/dopplerConfig bind this business's own tier; dopplerPlatformProject/dopplerPlatformConfig optionally bind the shared account-level `platform` project (knowledge/operations/doppler-organization.md) — cross-project inheritance is a paid Doppler feature, so adapters/provisioning/resolve.ts composes the two tiers itself at lookup time, business winning on conflict.
